description: Downloads a full KV snapshot and saves it to Google Drive for disaster recovery
makeSteps: 1. Schedule trigger: every day at 3:00 AM
3. Google Drive: Create file in SNS Backups/ folder — filename: sns-backup-{date}.json
4. Filter: if Drive upload failed → HTTP POST to /api/kv/confirm with error details
5. Optional: delete Drive files older than 30 days to save storage

payload.note: This scenario is schedule-triggered and pulls data from the app. No webhook payload needed.
